title: Martyrologium 1
author: Usuard of Saint-Germain
source_text:
INCIPIT USUARDI MARTYROLOGIUM PER ANNI CIRCULUM.

## PROLOGUS [cn: a | Deerat iste prologus in eo, quem publici juris facimus, codice manuscripto, propterea quod exciderat prae vetustate primum ejus folium. Eum vero nobis suppeditavit V. C. Pithaei exemplar ejusdem fere, tum characteris, tum aetatis, teste D. Jacobo du Breul, hujusce coenobii monacho, qui Prologi istius fronti observationem hanc praefixit. Notandum praeterea non reperiri in Solleriata Usuardi editione. BOUILLART.] AD CAROLUM CALVUM.

[0599A]Domino regum piissimo CAROLO USUARDUS, indignus sacerdos ac monachus, perennem in Christo coronam.

Minime vestram latet celsitudinem, o sapientissime princeps, qualiter monemur imitandis antiquorum studiis, ut quidquid in gestis praecipue ecclesiastico dogmati congruis minus perfectum inventum fuerit, debeamus vel pro posse supplere, vel certe suppleri obtare. Quae res pia quidem sollicitudine (vestro, si recordamini, jussu dignanter admoto) me ad hoc, etsi indignum, compulit, quatenus sanctorum sacras atque anniversario recolendas festivitates ex quibusdam praecedentium Patrum Martyrologiis in quamdam colligerem unitatem. Recolebamque in ipsis eorumdem solempnitatibus [0599B] quam multos propriae negligentiae excessus, quos etiam purgari tali cupiebam officio. Praeterea et venerabilium Hieronymi scilicet ac Bedae presbyterorum piis, quamvis succinctis, super hoc provocabar descriptis; quorum prior brevitati studens, alter vero quamplures dies intactos relinquens, [0600A] multa inveniuntur hujus operis praeterisse necessaria. Quos tamen secutus censui, et Flori viri memorabilis latiora jam in eo ipso negotio sequi vestigia, praesertim in secundo ejusdem libro. Ibi enim multa, quae in priore omiserat, et correxit et addidit. At si quid praeter quod ab illis accepi in hoc opere actum vel mutatum est, sagaci a me indagine id perquisitum agnosci poterit. Caeterum, benignissime, idcirco hanc exiguitatis meae praefatiunculam huic opusculo inserere malui, ut sciretur non me in hoc usum levitatis conamine, sed potius vestris, ut erat dignum, paruisse imperiis catholicorum fidelium solito consulentibus utilitati. Unde quod vestrum est obsecro, ut si justum decernitur, propria tuitionis anchora roboretur, quod videlicet [0600B] et praesentibus regalis examinis auctoritate, et futuris tantae auctoritatis firmetur examine. Excellentiam magnitudinis vestrae per multa annorum curricula Rex regum Dominus sua dignetur custodire potentia. Amen.

## PROLOGUS [cn: a | Desideratur secundus iste prologus in ea quam Sollerius adornavit Usuardi editione; at reperitur in Usuardi ejusdem codicibus fere omnibus manu exaratis, qui in bibliotheca Pratensi asservantur et in multis aliis. BOUILLART.] ALTER EX LIBRIS BEATI AUGUSTI. *Qualiter colendi sint sancti.*

[0599]

[0599C]Festivitates sanctorum apostolorum seu martyrum antiqui Patres in venerationis mysterio celebrari sanxerunt, vel ad excitandam imitationem, vel ut meritis eorum consociemur, atque orationibus adjuvemur [n: (AUG, l. XX, contr. Faust., c. 21)]. Ita tamen ut nulli martyrum, sed ipsi Deo martyrum sacrificemus, quamvis in memoriis martyrum constituamus altaria. Nemo enim in locis sanctorum corporum assistens altari aliquando dixit: Offerimus [0600C] tibi, Petre, aut Paule, aut Cypriane; sed quod offertur, offertur Deo, qui martyres coronavit: ut ex ipsorum locorum amore affectus assurgat ad augendam charitatem, et in illos quos imitari possumus, et in illum quo adjuvante possimus. Colimus ergo martyres eo cultu dilectionis et societatis quo et in hac vita coluntur sancti homines Dei, quorum cor ad talem pro evangelica veritate passionem paratum sentimus. Sed illos tanto devotius, quanto securius. [0601A] Quos etiam fidentiori laude praedicamus jam in vita feliciore victores, quam in ista adhuc usque pugnantes. At vero illo cultu, qui Graece latria dicitur, Latine uno verbo dici non potest, cum sit propria quaedam Divinitati debita servitus, nec colimus, nec colendum docemus, nisi unum Deum. Cum autem ad hunc cultum pertineat oblatio sacrificii, unde idololatrae dicuntur qui hoc etiam idolis exhibent, nullo modo aliquid tale offerimus aut offerendum praecipimus, vel cuiquam martyri, vel cuiquam sanctae animae, vel cuiquam angelo. Et quisquis in hunc errorem delabitur, corripitur per sanam doctrinam, sive ut corrigatur, sive ut condemnetur; dum etiam ipsi sancti, vel homines, vel angeli exhiberi [0602A] sibi nolunt, quod uni Deo deberi norunt. Apparuit hoc in Paulo et Barnaba, cum, commoti miraculis quae per eos facta sunt, Lycaonii tanquam diis immolare voluerunt. Conscissis enim vestimentis suis confitentes et persuadentes se deos non esse, ista sibi fieri vetuerunt [n: (Act. XIV, 14)]. Apparuit et in angelis, sicut et in Apocalypsi legimus angelum se adorari prohibentem atque dicentem adoratori suo: *Conservus tuus sum et fratrum tuorum, Deum adora [n: (Apoc. XIX, 10)]*. Honorandi sunt ergo martyres propter imitationem, non adorandi propter religionem. Honorandi sunt charitate, non servitute.

## MENSIS JANUARIUS HABET DIES XXXI.

[0601]

## *Kalendis. Die* 1.

[0601]

Circumcisio Domini nostri Jesu Christi. Romae, natalis sancti Almachii martyris; qui, jubente Urbis praefecto, cum diceret: Hodie Octavae Dominici diei sunt, cessate a superstitionibus idorum, a gladiatoribus occisus est. Via Appia, coronae militum triginta, sub Diocletiano imperatore. Item Romae, sanctae Martinae virginis, quae sub Alexandro imperatore diversis tormentorum generibus cruciata, tandem gladio martyrii palmam adepta est. Apud Spoletum, sancti Concordii presbyteri, et martyris, temporibus Antonini imperatoris; qui primo fustibus caesus, dehinc equuleo suspensus, ac ferro post in carcere maceratus, ibique angelica visitatione consolatus, demum gladio vitam finivit. In Caesarea Cappadociae, depositio sancti Basilii episcopi, cujus celebritas XVIII Kalend. Julii potissimum recolitur. In Africa, beati Fulgentii, ecclesiae Ruspensis episcopi, qui ob catholicam fidem, et eximiam doctrinam exilio relegatus, tandem ad propriam ecclesiam redire permissus, vita et verbo clarus, sancto fine quievit. In territorio Lugdunensi, sancti Eugendi [ *Bouillart.*, Augendi] abbatis, cujus vita virtutibus et miraculis plena refulsit. Alexandriae, sanctae Eufrosinae virginis.

## IV *Nonas. Die* 2.

[0605]

Apud Antiochiam, passio B. Isidori episcopi. Et in Ponto civitate Thomis, trium fratrum Argei, Marcelli [0607] [ *Bouillart.,* Narcissi] et Marcellini pueri, qui sub Licinio principe inter tyrones comprehensus, cum nollet militare, caesus ad mortem, et diu in carcere maceratus, martyrium consummavit. In Thebaide, S. Macharii abbatis.

## III *Nonas. Die* 3.

[0609]

Romae via Appia, natalis beati Antheros papae [cn: a | Pratensis codex omittit vocem *papae*, inquit Sollerius, et legit *cimiterio Calixti*. Utrobique falsum a suo monitore fuisse textus hic a nobis redditus arguit. BOUILL.], qui cum duodecim annis rexisset Ecclesiam, passus est sub Maximiano, et in cimiterio Calixti sepultus. Eodem die, sancti Petri, qui apud civitatem Aulanam crucis supplicio est interemptus. In Hellesponto, sanctorum martyrum Cyrici, Primi et Theogenis. Civitate Parisius, sanctae Genovefae virginis, quae a beato Germano Autisiodorensi episcopo, Christo dicata, admirandis virtutibus et miraculis late claruit.

## II *Nonas. Die* 4.

[0613]

Natalis beati Titi, qui ordinatus ab apostolo Paulo Cretensium episcopus, ac predicationis officium fidelissime complens, beatum finem adeptus est, ibique sepultus apud ecclesiam ubi fuerat dignus minister constitutus. Apud Africam, praeclarissimorum martyrum, Aquilini, Gemini, Eugenti, Martiani, Quinti, Theodoti, Triphonis, quorum gesta habentur. Romae, sanctorum Prisci presbiteri et Priscilliani clerici, ac Benedictae religiosae; qui sub tempore Juliani imperatoris gladio martyrium compleverunt. Item Romae, sanctae Dafrosae, uxoris Fabiani martyris, quae post interfectionem ipsius, primum relegata exilio, dein a praefato principe, capite jussa est puniri. Civitate Bononia, Hermetis, Aggei, et Gai.

## *Nonis. Die* 5.

[0617]

Romae, natalis beati Thelesphori papae, qui septimus post Petrum apostolum pontifex ordinatus, illustre martyrium duxit. Apud Antiochiam, sancti Simeonis monachi, cujus vita, ac conversatio satis extitit admirabilis.

## VIII *Idus. Die* 6.

[0619]

Epiphania Domini. In territorio Remensi, passio sanctae Macrae virginis; quae jubente Rictiovaro praeside, cum in ignem esset praecipitata, et permansisset illaesa, dein mammillis abscisis, et squalore carceris afflicta, super testas etiam acutissimas [ *Bouillart. add.* et prunas] volutata, orans migravit ad Dominum. Redonis, sancti Melanii episcopi et confessoris, qui post signa virtutum, jugiter intentus coelo, migravit a saeculo.

## VII *Idus. Die* 7.

[0623]

Relatio pueri Jesu ex Aegypto. Eodem die, beati Luciani Antiochenae ecclesiae presbyteri, et martyris, qui satis clarus doctrina et eloquentia, passus est Nicomediae ob confessionem Christi sub persecutione Maximini, sepultusque Helenopoli Bithiniae. Apud Antiochiam, sancti Cleri diaconi, qui pro confessionis gloria septies tortus et in carcere diu maceratus, ad ultimum decollatus, martyrium consummavit. Civitate Heraclea, Felicis, Januarii.

## VI *Idus. Die* 8.

[0627]

Neapoli Campaniae, natalis sancti Severini episcopi, et confessoris, fratris beatissimi Victorini martyris, qui Severinus post multarum virtutum perpetrationem, plenus sanctitate quievit. Beluacus, sanctorum martyrum Luciani presbiteri, Maxiani et Juliani, quorum Maxianus et Julianus primo a persecutoribus gladio puniti sunt. Dein beatus Lucianus post nimiam caedem, cum Christi nomen viva voce confiteri non metuisset, priorum sententiam et ipse excepit. Eodem die, sancti Eugeniani martyris.



## V *Idus. Die* 9.

[0631]

Apud Antiochiam sub Diocletiano et Maximiano, natalis sanctorum Juliani, et Basilissae virginis, quorum mirae passiones leguntur. Ex quorum etiam collegio venerabilis multitudo sacerdotum, et ministrorum ecclesiae Christi igne cremata est, quae ad eos confugerat propter immanitatem persecutionis. Post quos Antoninus presbyter, Anastasius et Celsus puer una cum matre, atque alii plures passi sunt. Mauritania Caesariensi, sanctae Martianae virginis. Apud Smirnam, sanctorum Vitalis, Revocati, et Fortunati. [ *Apud Bouillart . . . . .* passi sunt. [cn: a | *Observat Castellanus codicis ipsius inspector*, verba sunt Sollerii, *ex praetenso illo autographo avulsum olim folium, subinde vetusto etiam charactere restitutum, in quo ea mutatio facta sit*. Cum caeteri Usuardini codices habeant: *Apud Smirnam, sanctorum Vitalis, Revocati et Fortunati*: aliud est folium, fateor: an alia manus, dubito; certe idem litterarum ingenium, eadem utriusque scripturae aetas. Forte folio lituris correctionibusve sordidiori aliud subrogaverit Usuardus; praesto non fuerit idem scriptor. Neque temere id conjicio. Nam ubicunque Dervensis codex dissidet a Pratensi, in isto liturae sunt; aut si nitida pagina est, manum, aequalem quidem, sed tamen aliam animadverto. Cujus rei causam inquirenti haec visa est probabilis et perpetuo auctorum usu comprobata. Antequam Usuardus dictaret Martyrologium, multa correxerat, post dictatum multa: cum sordidius factum esset folium, quam ut commodo scriptura legi posset, avulso folio, aliud substituit. Itaque Vitalem, Revocatum et Fortunatum concede ad primum pertinuisse autographum. In secundo locum cesserunt Revoluto et Firmino. Unde petiti fuerunt? Ignoro. Nova in dies sanctorum Acta e bibliothecarum angulis emergunt. Emergent fortasse quae Usuardus vidit. Ad Revolutum et Firminum ex Africanis aut Smyrnensibus esse, quos hoc die consignant caetera Martyrologia, id affirmari non potest, nisi forte ἀναλφάβητος Usuardus fuerit. Nam neque numerus convenit, neque ulla nominum inter se necessitudo est. BOUILLART.] In Affrica sanctorum martyrum Revoluti et Firmini cum aliis tribus.]

## IV *Idus. Die* 10.

[0635]

Apud Cyprum, beati Nichanoris diaconi de septem primis, qui gratia fidei, et virtute admirandus, gloriosissime coronatus est. In Thebaide, natalis beati Pauli primi heremitae, cujus animam inter apostolorum, et prophetarum choros ad coelum ferri ab angelis sanctus Antonius vidit.

## III *Idus. Die* 11.

[0637]

In Africa, natalis beati Salvii. In hujus natali sanctus Augustinus verbum fecit ad populum Cartagini. Apud Alexandriam, sanctorum confessorum Petri, Leucii, quorum gesta habentur.

## *Pridie Idus. Die* 12.

[0641]

Apud Achaiam, natalis beati Satyri martyris, qui transiens ante quoddam idolum, cum exsufflasset illud, signans sibi frontem, statim corruit, ob quam causam decollatus est. Eodem die, sancti Archadii martyris, genere et miraculis clari. [ *Apud Bouillart.:* [cn: a | Quem Archadium Caesareae in Mauritania passum testantur tum Archadii ejusdem acta, tum alia etiam Usuardi Martyrologia. Quid ex hac pugna colligemus? Codicem nostrum, ut Sollerio videtur, Usuardi manu exaratum non esse? Minime gentium. Sed Usuardo vel ignota penitus fuisse, vel non visa haec sancti Archadii Acta; indeque in eum incidisse errorem quem alii postmodum ejus Martyrologii scriptores emendarint. Usuardi porro in manus venire potuerunt codices nonnulli in quos eo irrepsit facilius idem eror quod ea aetate vulgaris fuisse videatur. Plures Ruinartius noster Act. select. Mart., pag 590, laudat, nominatimque Colbertinos duos, unum R. R. P. P. Fuliensium, alterum Remigiano monasterio Hincmari Rhemensis episcopi dono datum in quibus sanctum Archadium Caesareae in Mauritania passum esse legitur. Eidem monasterio largitus quoque est idem antistes exemplar tractatuum S. Zenonis Veronensis episcopi, quorum trigesimus nonus libri primi sic inscribitur; *De natale S. Archadii qui habet natale pridie Id. Januar. in civitate Caesareae in Mauritania.* BOUILLART.] In Caesarea Mauritaniae sancti Archadii, martyris genere et miraculis clari.]

## *Idus. Die* 13.

[0645]

Romae via Lavicana, coronae militum quadraginta, quas sub Galieno imperatore pro confessione verae fidei percipere meruerunt. Pictavis civitate, natalis sancti Hilarii episcopi et confessoris, qui ob catholicam fidem quadriennio apud Phrygiam relegatus, inter alias virtutes, fertur quod mortuum suscitaverit. Remis metropoli, depositio sancti Remigii episcopi, viri eximiae virtutis. Cujus sanctitatis praeconium, merito credulitatis suae, gens Francorum debitae venerationis cultu celebriter recolit. [ *Addit. Bouillart., cursivo charactere:* [cn: a | Verba haec, *In monte Verziaco*, etc., a recentiori manu adjecta esse Castellanus recte observavit. Quod additamentum tamen sola Bollando causa fuit cur Heriniensem Pratensi codice existimaret esse puriorem. BOUILLART.] In monte Verziaco, sancti Viventii confessoris.

## XIX *Kal. Die* 14.

[0649]

Apud Nolam Campaniae, natalis sancti Felicis presbyteri [ *Bouillart.,* episcopi] [cn: a | Et hic oculos habuit Castellanus. Spatiolum, ub prima manu legitur *episcopi*, erasum fuit. Item secuudi sancti Felicis annuntiatio in litura jacet, saltem haec verba: *Item eodem die.* An Usuardo satis fuerit. S. Felicem episcopum designatum atque electum a populo fuisse, ut illum episcopum diceret, quaerere non est animus. Non mentem, sed verba praestare debeo. Quod alium addit Felicem, si culpa alii permulti, qui in paucis differunt, ut infra patebit, est, non solius Usuardi fuit. Ado ipse duorum Felicium acta permiscuit, quorum alterius alterum fratrem esse dixerunt alii ante Usuardum Martyrologi. Dolenda sors ejus, qui duces minime tutos secutus est; et hac in re erga Usuardum eo aequior debet esse Sollerius, quo ipse manifestius culpa tenetur, quam in illo reprehenderet. BOUILLART.] et confessoris, de quo beatus scribit Paulinus, quia cum a persecutoribus in carcerem mitteretur, et cocleis et testulis superpositus jaceret, per noctem ab angelo solutus atque eductus sit. Eodem die, sancti Eufrasii episcopi.

## XVIII *Kal.* Die 15.

[0653]

Abbacuc et Micheae prophetarum, quorum corpora sub Archadio imperatore, divina revelatione reperta sunt. Apud Aegyptum, beati Macharii abbatis, discipuli beati Antonii, et vita et miraculis celeberrimi. Item, sancti Isidori, in sanctitate vitae, fide ac miraculis praeclari. Civitate Arvernis, sancti Boniti [0655] episcopi et confessoris, cujus vita virtutibus refulsit. In territorio Andegavensi, sancti [cn: a | Quod Usuardus sanctum Maurum non vocat beati Benedicti discipulum, hinc efficit Sollerius, suae dialecticae non satis memor, Usuardum de discipulo sancti Benedicti nunquam cogitasse, et saeculo nono jam adulto Maurum Andegavensem inter Benedicti discipulos a Benedictinis ipsis connumerari non consuevisse. Cum id unum sequatur, non alium tunc temporis notum fuisse Maurum Andegavensem, praeter sancti Benedicti discipulum, proinde supervacuum Usuardo visum fuisse ullam notam addere, qua Maurus Andegavensis ab alio distingueretur. Sed inquit, *quis sobrie credat id taciturum Usuardum, qui Paulo ante in eodem textu Macarium Antonii discipulum praedicavit?* Nemo sobrius non videt cur id de Macarii dixerit: nempe qnod plures fuerunt Macarii abbates, unus Antonii discipulus. At ego rogo vicissim: quis prudens crediderit sanctum abbatem, qui Benedictinae familiae decus et propagator fuit, Benedictino nunquam in mentem venisse et in concinnando sanctorum catalogo fuisse praetermissum? BOUILLARD.] Mauri abbatis.

## XVII *Kal.* Die 16.

[0657]

Roma via Salaria, natalis sancti Marcelli papae, qui ob catholicae fidei defensionem, jubente Maximino tyranno, primo fustibus caesus, deinde ad servitium animalium cum custodia publica deputatus, post multos annos ibidem serviendo amictu inductus cilicino defunctus est. Apud Arelatem, beati Honorati episcopi, cujus vita, doctrina et miraculis illustris fuit. [ *Interserit Bouillart.:* [cn: a | Sanctum Titianum expunxit Sollerius, quamvis is sit mss. consensus, ut torrenti fere cedendum putaverit. Cur tamen reluctaretur, in causa fuit haec sui monitoris observatio: deletum in Pratensi fuisse quidquid *Arelatem* inter et *S. Fursei* prima manu scriptum fuerat. Verum est hic lituram esse. Sed qui locum erasit, idem superiora scripserat. Tantum litteras paulo magis densavit ut locus daretur S. Titiano, quem in primo autographo praetermiserat. Titianus ille est Opiterginae civitatis episcopus, quem hoc die memorant edita Usuardi Martyrologia et Martyrologium Germanicum; cujus Acta ex antiquis Opiterginae ecclesiae monumentis conscripsit Ferrarius. Haec refert Bollandus haec eadem die. BOUILLART.] Item civitate Odobergia sancti Titiani episcopi et confessoris.] Parrona monasterio, sancti Fursei confessoris.

## XVI *Kal. Die* 17.

[0663]

Apud Thebaidam, beati Antonii monachi, cujus corpus, sub Justiniano imperatore divina revelatione repertum, Alexandriae delatum est, et in ecclesia sancti Joannis Baptistae humatum. Lingonis, natalis sanctorum geminorum Speusippi, Elasippi et Melasippi. Qui cum essent viginti quinque annorum, cum avia sua Leonilla, et Jonilla, et Neone martyrio coronati sunt, tempore Aureliani imperatoris. Bituricas civitate, depositio sancti Sulpitii episcopi, cujus vita et mors pretiosa gloriosis miraculis commendatur.

## XV *Kal. Die* 18.

[0665]

Cathedrae sancti Petri apostoli, qua Romae primum sedit. Et passio sanctae Priscae virginis. Apud Pontum, natalis sanctorum martyrum Mosei et Ammonii, qui cum essent milites primo ad metalla deputati, novissime igni traditi sunt. [ *Bouillart. in Margine:* Parisius, monasterio sancti Germani, dedicatio altaris in honore victoriosissimae crucis, et beatae et gloriosae semperque virginis Mariae et sanctorum martyrum Mauricii sociorumque ejus.]

## XIV *Kal. Die* 19.

[0669]

[0669]In Smirna, Natalis beati Germanici martyris, qui sub Marco Antonino et Lucio Aurelio, per gratiam virtutis Dei, metum corporeae fragilitatis excludens, sponte praeparatam bestiam provocavit: cujus dentibus comminutus, vero pani, id est Domino Jesu Christo, pro ipso moriens, meruit incorporari. Apud Spoletum, sancti Pontiani martyris, temporibus Antonini imperatoris, quem judex pro Christo vehementissime virgis caesum, jussit super carbones nudis pedibus ambulare: a quibus nil laesus, equuleo et uncinis ferreis jussus est suspendi, et sic in carcerem trudi; ubi angelica visitatione meruit confortari, post quae plumbo fervente perfusus, tandem gladio percussus est. In pago Dorcasino, sancti Launomari presbyteri.

## XIII *Kal. Die* 20.

[0673]

Romae, natalis beati Fabiani papae, qui cum tredecim annis Ecclesiae praeesset, martyrium est passus tempore Decii, et in cimiterio Calisti sepultus. Eodem die Catacumbas, sancti Sebastiani martyris, qui cum haberet principatum primae cohortis, jussus est sub titulo Christianitatis a Diocletiano imperatore ligari in medio campo, et sagittari a militibus, atque ad ultimum fustigari donec deficeret. Via Cornelia, sanctorum martyrum Marii, et Marthae cum filiis suis Audifax et Abacuc, nobilium de Persida, qui ad orationem venerant Romam tempore Claudii principis. E quibus post toleratos fustes, equuleum, ignes, ungues, manuum praecisionem, Martha in nympha necata, caeteri sunt decollati, et corpora eorum incensa.

## XII *Kal. Die* 21.

[0677]

Natalis beati Publii episcopi, qui secundus post Dionysium Areopagitam Atheniensium Ecclesiam nobiliter rexit, et praeclarus virtutibus, ac doctrina praefulgens, ob Christi martyrium gloriose coronatur. Romae, passio sanctae Agnetis virginis, quae sub praefecto Urbis Symphronio ignibus injecta, sed his per orationem ejus extinctis, gladio percussa est. In Hispaniis civitate Tarracona, sanctorum martyrum Fructuosi episcopi, Augurii et Eulogii diaconorum, qui tempore Galieni in primo carcere trusi, deinde flammis injecti, exustis vinculis, manibus in modum crucis expansis, orantes ut urerentur obtinuerunt. Trecas, sancti Patrocli martyris.

## XI *Kal. Die* 22.

[0679]

Natalis sancti Timothaei, discipuli beati Pauli. Hic ab eodem Apostolo episcopus Epheso ordinatus, post multos pro Christo agones, martyrio coronatus est. Eodem die apud civitatem Valentiam, sub Daciano Hispaniarum praeside, sancti Vincentii Levitae, et martyris. Cujus passionis nobilem triumphum conspicuus versificator Prudentius luculenter versibus exsequitur: sanctus quoque Augustinus ejusdem martyris praeconium, [0681] quantum sit laudis honore excipiendum, quodam sermone commendat. [ *Bouillart. Legit.:* [cn: a | Bollandum, qui nostram lectionem praetulit, a Pratensi codice deceptum esse ait Sollerius, sed si non fuisset ipse a suo male oculato monitore deceptus, sodali suo multo plus honoris habuisset. Falsum est enim, quod admonuit Castellanus, *ab imperito fortasse quopiam erasum fuisse* elogium, quod Sollerius repraesentavit. Quae manus Sollerianum textum primo exaraverat, et postea erasit, eadem Bollandianum nostrumve ejus loco substituit. Appello peritos hujus generis litteraturae judices. Qui vero haec cohaerent? Nihil expeditu facilius. Usuardus suum exemplum ut primum scripserat, exscribi permisit. Hinc exemplaria, unde suum Vincentii elogium prompsit Sollerius. Postquam autem suum ad se codicem recepit, oblitteravit quod sibi minus rectum videbatur; subjecit quod magis placebat. [0687]

[0691]

[0709]

## MENSIS FEBRUARIUS HABET DIES XXVIII.

[0717]

## *Kalendis. Die* 1.

[0717]

Natalis beati Ignatii episcopi et martyris, qui tertius post Petrum apostolum Antiochenam rexit ecclesiam: ac persecutione Trajani Romam vinctus mittitur, ubi praesente eodem, circumsedente senatu, immanissimis poenarum suppliciis primo affectus, dehinc leonibus objicitur, eorumque dentibus praefocatus, hostia Christi efficitur. Apud Smirnam, sancti Pionii martyris, qui post squalorem carceris, ubi multos fratrum ad martyrii tolerantiam suis exhortationibus roboravit, cruciatibus multis vexatus, clavis confixus, et ardenti rogo superpositus, beatum pro Christo vitae finem sortitus est. Passi sunt cum eo et alii quindecim. Eodem die, beati Ephrem Edessenae ecclesiae diaconi. In oppido Tricastrino, sancti Pauli episcopi, [0719] cujus et vita virtutibus claruit, et mors pretiosa miraculis commendatur. In Scotia, sanctae Brigidae virginis, cujus vita miraculis claruit.

## IV *Non. Die* 2.

[0721]

Ypapanti Domini. Apud Caesaream, beatissimi Cornelii Centurionis, quem Beatus Petrus baptizavit. Hic apud praefatam urbem episcopali honore sublimatus quievit. Romae via Salaria, passio sancti Aproniani, qui audiens una cum Sisinnio diacono, adhuc gentilis, vocem de coelo factam, *Venite,* inquiens, *benedicti Patris mei* et reliqua; credens, baptizatus est, et sic postea in confessione Domini finem vitae capitali sententia [0723] accepit. [0725]

[0729]

In civitate Aegypti, quae appellatur Thmuis, passio beati Fileae episcopi et Filoromi tribuni, cum quibus etiam innumera fidelium multitudo ex eadem urbe, pastoris sui sequens exemplum, martyrio coronata est, sicut octavus liber ecclesiasticae Historiae loquitur. ## *Nonis Die* 5.

Apud Siciliam civitate Cathanensium, natalis sanctae Agathae virginis et martyris, quae post alapas et carcerem, post equuleum et tortiones, post mamillarum abscisionem, post volutationem in testulis et carbonibus, tandem sub judice Quintiano in carcere consummata est. [0753]

## XVI *Kal. Die* 14.

[0759]

[0763]

Novissime vero septem mulieres, quae guttas sanguinis ejus defluentes colligebant, deprehensae quod essent Christianae, post dira tormenta, gladio percussae sunt. ## XIV *Kal. Die* 16.

[0767]

## XIII *Kal. Die* 17.

[0769]

## XII *Kal. Die* 18.

[0773]

Natalis beati Simeonis episcopi et martyris, qui propinquus Salvatoris secundum carnem extitisse dinoscitur, ac filius Cleophae, qui fuit frater Joseph. Hic Hierosolimorum episcopus post Jacobum fratrem Domini ordinatus, persecutione Trajani multo tempore suppliciis affectus, martyrio consummatus est. Omnibus qui aderant et ipso judice mirantibus, ut centum viginti annorum senex crucis supplicium pertulisset. Civitate Ostia, sanctorum martyrum Maximi, Claudii et uxoris ejus Prepedignae cum duobus filiis, qui cum essent praeclarissimi generis, jubente Diocletiano sunt tenti, atque in exilium deportati; deinde incendio concremati, odoriferum sacrificium martyrii Deo reddiderunt.

## XI *Kal. Die* 19.

[0777]

Romae, natalis sancti Gabinii presbyteri et martyris, qui a Diocletiano diu in custodia vinculis afflictus, pretiosa morte coeli gaudia comparavit. In Africa, sanctorum Publii et Juliani.

## X *Kal. Die* 20.

[0779]

Apud Tyrum civitatem, beatorum martyrum, quorum numerum solius Dei scientia colligit. Qui jubente Diocletiano, multis tormentorum suppliciis sibi invicem succedentibus occisi sunt. Primo quidem flagris per omne corpus dilaniati, dehinc diversis bestiarum generibus traditi, sed ab his divina virtute custoditi, post addita feritate ignis et ferri, martyrium consummarunt. Horum gloriosam multitudinem incitabant ad victoriam Tyrannio et Silvanus, sed et Peleus atque Linus episcopi, Zenobius quoque presbiter, qui felici agone una cum eis martyrii palmam adeptus est. In Cypro insula, sanctorum Potamii, et Nemesii. Alemannia, sancti Galli presbiteri et confessoris.

## IX *Kal. Die* 21.

[0781]

Apud Siciliam, sanctorum martyrum septuaginta novem, qui sub Diocletiano per diversa tormenta confessionis suae coronam a Christo sibi paratam percipere meruerunt. In Africa civitate Adrumeto, sanctorum Veroli, secundini, Servuli et aliorum viginti. [ *Bouillart., ad oram paginae:* Apud monasterium S. Germani, consecratio altaris in honore beatorum martyrum Johannis et Pauli et S. Blasii necnon sanctorum confessorum Benedicti, Lupi et Egidii. Item consecratio altaris in honore SS. Innocentum et SS. virg. Columbae, Margaritae, Catherinae.]

## VIII *Kal. Die* 22.

[0785]

Apud Antiochiam, Cathedrae [ *Bouillart., Cathedra* ] sancti Petri. Eodem die, beati Papiae Hierapolitanae civitatis episcopi, qui Joannis apostoli auditor, Polycarpi autem condiscipulus et sodalis fuit. Item, sancti Aristionis, qui fuit unus de septuaginta duobus Christi discipulis. Alexandriae, sancti Abilii episcopi, qui post beatum Marcum secundus episcopus, tredecim annos sacerdotium virtute conspicuus ministravit, [ *Apud Bouillart., ad oram paginae:* Eodem die consecratio altaris in honore beatorum martyrum Eustachii sociorumque ejus et sancti confessoris Christi Medardi.]

## VII *Kal. Die* 23.

[0787]

Apud Syrmium, beati Sineri monachi et martyris, qui jubente Maximiano imperatore tentus, cum se Christianum esse confiteretur, capite caesus est. Item natalis sexaginta duorum, qui martyrii certamen in praefata urbe consummantes, regna mansura perceperunt. Ipso die, sancti Policarpi presbiteri et confessoris, qui cum beato Sebastiano plurimos ad Christi fidem convertit, atque ad martyrii gloriam exhortando perduxit.

## VI *Kal. Die* 24.

[0791]

Natalis beati Matthiae apostoli, qui post ascensionem Domini ab apostolis sorte electus, apud Judaeam Christi Evangelium, praedicavit. Item, inventio capitis Praecursoris Domini, tempore Martiani principis, quando idem Praecursor duobus monachis, primum, ubi idem ejus caput celatum jaceret, revelavit. In Caesarea Cappadociae, sancti Sergii martyris, cujus gesta praeclarissima habentur.

## V *Kal. Die* 25.

[0793]

Apud Aegyptum, natalis sanctorum Victorini, Victoris, Nicofori, Claudiani, Dioscori, Serapionis et Papiae sub Numeriano imperatore: quorum primus, secundus et tertius pro confessione deitatis constanter exquisita suppliciorum genera tolerantes, reliqui quatuor Claudianus et Dioscorus flammis incensi. Serapionis et Papias gladio caesi sunt. Omnes itaque celebre martyrium dedicaverunt.

## IV *Kal. Die* 26.

[0797]

In civitate Pergen Pamphiliae, natalis beati Nestoris episcopi, qui persecutione Decii, cum die noctuque orationi insisteret, postulans ut grex Christi custodiretur, comprehensus, nomen Domini mira libertate, et alacritate confessus, equuleo crudelissime tortus est. Exin crucis suspendio victor migravit. Apud Alexandriam, sancti Alexandri episcopi, gloriosi senis. Hic post beatum Petrum, Arrium presbyterum suum haeretica impietate depravatum, et divina veritate convictum, de ecclesia ejecit, ac postea inter trecentos decem et octo Patres, et eumdem in Nicaeno concilio damnavit.

## III *Kal. Die* 27.

[0799]

Alexandriae, passio sancti Juliani martyris. Is cum ita podagra constrictus esset, ut neque incedere, neque stare posset, una cum Euno ministro suo, in sella judici offertur; qui camelis impositi jubentur per totam circumduci urbem, et flagris hinc inde inspectante populo laniari, usquequo finem ipsis verberibus sortirentur. In Hispaniis civitate Hispali, natalis sancti Leandri episcopi et confessoris, cujus praedicatione et industria, tota Gothorum gens per Recharedum regem ab Ariana impietate conversa est. Lugduni, sancti Baldomeris viri Dei, cujus sepulcrum crebris miraculis illustratur.

## *Pridie Kal. Die* 28.

[0803]

In territorio Lugdunensi locis Jurensibus, depositio beati Romani abbatis, qui primus illic vitam heremiticam duxit, et multis virtutibus ac miraculis clarus, plurimorum postea pater extitit monachorum. Eodem die, sanctorum Macharii et Rufini.

## MENSIS MARTIUS HABET DIES XXXI.

[0805]

## *Kalendis Die* 1.

[0805]

Romae, sanctorum martyrum ducentorum sexaginta, quos jussit primo Claudius pro Christi nomine damnatos arenam fodere. Deinde praecepit, ut foras muros portae Salariae mitterentur, et in amphitheatro ejusdem civitatis militum sagittis interficerentur. Eodem die, sancti Donati martyris, qui sub duce Ursacio et Marcellino tribuno Carthagini passus est. Andegavis, sancti Albani [ *Bouillart.,* Albini] episcopi et confessoris, viri praeclarissimae virtutis et sanctitatis. Civitate Massilia sanctorum Hermetis et Adriani.

## VI *Non. Die* 2.

[0809]

Romae via Latina, sanctorum martyrum Jovini et Basilei, qui passi sunt sub Galieno et Valeriano imperatoribus. Item Romae plurimorum martyrum, quos diu cruciatos, imperator Alexander capitali sententia in extremo damnavit.



## V *Non. Die* 3.

[0811]

Apud Caesaream Palestinae, sanctorum martyrum Marini militis et Asterii senatoris, sub persecutione Valeriani; quorum prior cum accusatus fuisset a comilitonibus, quod esset Christianus, et ille Christianum se esse clarissima voce testaretur, martyrii coronam capitis abscisione suscepit. Cumque sequens, capite truncatum martyris corpus subjectis humeris et substrata veste, qua induebatur, exciperet, honorem, quem martyri detulit, continuo ipse martyr accepit. Eodem die, natalis sanctorum Emetherii et Celedonii, qui primum apud Legionensem Galliciae civitatem milites, exsurgente persecutionis procella, pro confessione nominis Christi, plurimis afflicti tormentis, Calagurrim usque perducti, atque ibi martyrio coronati sunt.

## IV *Non. Die* 4.

[0815]

Romae via Appia, natalis beati Lucii papae et martyris, qui persecutione Valeriani et Galieni, ob fidem Christi exilio relegatus et postmodum divino nutu ad ecclesiam suam redire permissus, martyrium capitis obtruncatione complevit. Item Romae via Appia, sanctorum martyrum nongentorum, qui sunt positi in cimiterio ad sanctam Caeciliam. Eodem die, sancti Caii palatini in mare mersi.

## III *Non. Die* 5.

[0817]

Apud Antiochiam, natalis beati Focae martyris, qui post multas, quas pro nomine Redemptoris est passus, injurias, qualiter de antiquo illo serpente triumphaverit, hodieque populis declaratur. Ipso die passio sancti Eusebii palatini et aliorum novem martyrum.

## *Pridie Non. Die* 6.

[0819]

Nicomediae, natalis sanctorum Victoris et Victorini, qui per triennium cum Claudiano et Bassa uxore ejus, tormentis multis afflicti et retrusi in carcerem, ibidem vitae suae cursum impleverunt. Civitate Toleto, depositio Juliani episcopi, qui apud ejusdem loci incolas famosissimus habetur.

## *Nonis. Die* 7.

[0821]

In Mauritania civitate Tuburbitanorum, natalis sanctarum martyrum Perpetuae et Felicitatis, et cum eis Revocati, Saturnini et Secundoli, quorum ultimus in carcere quievit, reliqui omnes ad bestias sunt traditi sub Severo principe.

## VIII *Idus. Die* 8.

[0825]

In civitate Antinoum, natalis sanctorum Philemonis et Apollonii diaconi, qui tenti et a judice auditi, cum constanter idolis sacrificare noluissent, perforatis calcaneis per civitatem horribiliter tracti, novissime gladio caesi, martyrium compleverunt. Eodem die apud praefatam urbem, passio Arriani, Theotici, et aliorum trium; quos judex submersos in mare necavit, sed obsequio delphini, corpora eorum littori sunt restituta. Cartagini, sancti Pontii diaconi beati Cypriani episcopi, qui usque ad diem passionis illius cum eo exilium sustinens, egregium volumen vitae et passionis ipsius reliquit, ac clarus passionibus, coronam vitae promeruit.

## VII *Idus. Die* 9.

[0827]

Apud Nisenam civitatem depositio sancti Gregorii episcopi, fratris beati Basilii Caesariensis tam vita quam eloquentia clarissimi. Civitate Barcinona, sancti Patiani episcopi qui tempore Theodosii principis, optima senectute finem vitae sortitus est.

## VI *Idus. Die* 10.

[0829]

Apud Apamiam, natalis sanctorum Alexandri et Gaii martyrum, qui, ut Apollinaris scribit Hierapolitanus episcopus, in libro adversum Catafrigas, persecutione Antonini Veri, glorioso martyrio coronati sunt In Perside, sanctorum martyrum numero quadraginta duorum. Parisius, depositio sancti Droctovei abbatis discipuli beati Germani episcopi. [ *Bouillart. addit:* Ipso die [cn: a | Hic Pratensem codicem in jus vocat Sollerius, quod hujus diei sanctis adjungatur sanctus Attalus; cum exarati manu codices non pauci, iique quantivis pretii, sanctum illum abbatem non memorent, aliique alio modo: non credibile esse a mss. illis abfuturum, si fons ipse, unde illi ducti rivuli sunt, illum habuisset: suspicari itaque se verba Pratensis esse recentiora. Ut suas ipse ratiunculas refellat, unum oro, ut codicem inspectum veniat. Nam quid ponderis habent conjecturae contra id quod revera est? Neque nobis objiciat lituram. Nam et quadraginta duos martyres et Droctoveum abbatem Usuardi esse confitetur, qui tamen et ipsi in eadem litura scribuntur ac Attalus. Nec tamen inficior additum Attalum fuisse, quandoquidem de illo silet Dervensis codex. At Usuardo licuit suum, cum lubebat, et quibus sanctis lubebat, locupletare Martyrologium. Nec necesse fuit ut suum codicem, statim atque quidpiam in eo correxerat, quocunque transmitteret, aut per litteras notum faceret quid adjecisset codici, quid detraxisset. Jam hunc diem esse quo sanctus Attalus aut Attala commemorari debuit, ut probem nihil opus est. Acta ejus omnium versantur manibus, BOUILLART.] sancti Attali abbatis, discipuli sancti Columbani.]

## V *Idus. Die* 11.

[0833]

Apud Sebasten Armeniae minoris, natalis sanctorum quadraginta militum, qui tempore Licinii regis, post vincula et carceres creberrimos, post caesas lapidibus facies, missi sunt in stagnum, et sic demum crurifragio martyrium consummaverunt. Erant autem nobiliores [cn: a | Pratensis codex omisit vocem *nobiliores*. Observatio est Sollerii. Nulla tamen vox in toto articulo quae validius oculos feriat. BOUILLART.] inter eos, Quirion et Candidus.

## IV *Idus. Die* 12.

[0835]

Romae, beatorum pontificum Gregorii doctoris, ac apostoli Anglorum, et Innocentii. Apud Nicomediam, passio sancti Petri martyris. Hic cum esset cubicularius Diocletiani principis, et liberius causaretur de immensis martyrum suppliciis, jubente eodem, in medium educitur, ac primo suspensus, diutissime flagris torquetur, deinde aceto et sale perfusus, ad ultimum in craticula assatur, sicque veri Petri extitit et fidei haeres et nominis. Item Nicomediae, sanctorum Egduni presbiteri et aliorum septem, qui diebus singulis suffocati sunt, ut caeteris metus incuteretur.

## III *Idus. Die* 13.

[0839]

[0839]Apud Nicomediam, natalis sanctorum martyrum Macedonii presbyteri, Patriciae et Modestae. Nicea civitate, sanctorum martyrum Theusetae, Horris, Theodorae, Nimpodorae, Marci, Arabiae, qui omnes igni traditi sunt. In Thebaide, depositio sanctae Eufrasiae virginis.

## *Pridie Idus. Die* 14.

[0841]

Romae, passio sanctorum quadraginta et septem. Hi baptizati sunt a beato Petro apostolo, cum teneretur in custodia Mamertini, cum coapostolo suo Paulo, ubi novem menses detenti sunt; qui omnes sub devotissima fidei confessione, Neroniano gladio consumpti sunt. In Africa, sancti Petri martyris. Item sancti Eufrosii.

## *Idibus. Die* 15.

[0843]

In Caesarea Cappadociae, passio sancti Longini, qui latus Domini lancea perforavit, ut in gestis ejusdem invenitur. Apud Thessalonicam civitatem, natalis sanctae Matronae martyris, quae deprehensa et multipliciter afflicta, novissime robustis fustibus usque ad mortem caesa, in confessione Christi incorruptum Deo spiritum reddidit.

## XVII *Kal. Die* 16.

[0847]

Apud [cn: a | In Carolino autographo SS. Hilari et Tatiani mentio facta nunquam fuit. De illis enim Dervensis codex tacet, et a Cyriaco articuli exordium capit. Praeterea in Pratensi totus hic articulus a capite ad calcem litura laborat, et quo sanctis illis locus esset, minutiori litterarum forma totus exaratus est. Nec etiam sanctos illos memorant Heriniensis et Tornacensis codices, qui Sollerio plerumque pro norma fuerunt, ex qua Pratensem aestimaret. Hic Sollerium interrogo qua causa, anteposito Pratensi, a suis desciverit. In Pratensi litura erat, variabant alii codices. His duobus tantum argumentis ubique judicavit interpolatum esse Pratensem codicem. Hoc igitur loco, aut nusquam, sua regula locum habere debuit Articulum tamen totum reddit Sollerius: totus Usuardi est, Usuardus merus. De litura ne verbum quidem apud censorem; opinor, quia admonitus est nullam illic esse scripturae dissimilitudinem, et Usuardo laudi dandum esse, quod praestantium scriptorum exemplo nec turpem in scriptis putaverit lituram, nec metuerit. Cur eadem in causa, non eodem semper in Pratensem codicem animo fuerit Sollerius, ignorare malim, quam de veritatis studio, quo se ardere praedicat, quidlibet maligne suspicari. BOUILLART.] Aquileiam, natalis beati Hilarii episcopi et Tatiani diaconi, qui sub Beronio praeside, post equuleum atque alia tormenta, una cum Felice, Largo, et Dionysio martyrium terminarunt. Romae, passio sancti Cyriaci diaconi, qui post longam carceris macerationem, reliquata pice perfusus et in catasta extensus, ac tractus, etiam nervis et fustibus caesus, ad ultimum cum Largo et Smaragdo et aliis viginti, jubente Maximino, capite truncatus est. Horum tamen festivitas sexto Idus Augusti recolitur, quo die a beato Marcello papa eorum corpora sunt levata et venerabiliter tumulata. Arvernis, depositio sancti Patricii episcopi et confessoris.

## XVI *Kal. Die* 17.

[0849]

In Scotia, natalis sancti Patricii episcopi et confessoris, qui primus ibidem Christum evangelizavit. [0851] Eodem die monasterio Nivigella, sanctae Gertrudis virginis. [ *Apud Bouillart . . . . :* evangelizavit. Civitate Nicomedia, sanctorum martyrum Eugenii, Pamphiliani, Castoris et Sereni [cn: a | Ambigit Sollerius corruptumne dicat an mutatum codicem. Quatuor sancti martyres et male connexi, et perperam huc traducti. Gertrudis suo loco extrusa, inepte sanctis diei sequentis inserta, bini textus uno errore corrupti. Atque has injurias in lituram unius versus fundit is qui paulo ante totos novem versus erasos quieto et aequo animo tulit. Quid ad haec ego? Verum est sanctos illos martyres non fuisse in Carolino autographo memoratos, sed aut male connexos aut perperam huc traductos fuisse, quo argumento efficiet Sollerius? numquid habet Acta, quae proferat? Hieronymianos, sat scio, indices nobis obtrudet: sed in vetustissimis eorum codicibus ne unus quidem eorum legitur, de quibus hic Usuardus. Nec die hesterna actus erat. Sic enim illi, teste Henschenio: *Nicomediae, Castori, Dionysii, Nonni, Cyriacae, Milisae, Eugeniae, Juliani, Asclepiodoti.* Alii quidem codices, Castorem, alii Serenum, alii, una ex duabus classibus facta, Pamphilianum adnuntiant. Quid certi ex illa codicum conflictione extundi potest? forte Usuardus alios indices habuit; forte uno die utramque Nicomediensium martyrum classem conjunxit; forte Acta vidit. Denique quidvis potius conjectare mallem, quam, ut Sollerius, nullo argumento Codicem minime suspectum rejicere. De S. Gertrude mox in sequenti articulo. BOUILLART.].]

## XV *Kal. Die* 18.

[0853]

Natalis beati Alexandri episcopi, qui de Cappadocia, ex propria civitate, sancto desiderio Hierosolimam veniens, divina revelatione, ejus dein loci gubernaculum suscepit, et post venerandam senectutem ductus Caesaream, persecutione Decii ob confessionem Christi martyrium complevit. [ *Addit Bouillart.:* [cn: a | Verus est hic S. Gertrudis locus. Et miror qui falli potuerint Henschenius et alii, qui XVI Kal. hujus mensis mortem sanctae illius Virginis consignarunt. Gertrudem, com dies mortis immineret, misisse unum ex fratribus ad Fossuense monasterium, qui ab Ultano sancto ejus loci incola percontaretur quo die moritura esset: Ultanum respondisse: *Hodie decimus sextus Kalendas Aprilis est dies. ## XIV *Kal. Die* 19.

[0855D]

Natalis beati Joannis, magnae sanctitatis viri, qui de Syria oriundus pervenit ad Italiam: ibique apud Penarensem urbem constructo monasterio, multorum servorum Dei per quadraginta annos pater existens, multis clarus virtutibus quievit in pace. Eodem die apud Surrentum, sanctorum Quinti, Quintilli, Quartillae, Marci, cum aliis novem. Civitate Brixa, sancti Caloceri [cn: a | Non solum nomen *Caloceri*, ut notavit Castellanus, sed etiam totum illud spatium a *sanctorum* ad finem deletum est. Nec id obstat tamen quin textus Usuardini codicis purus esse Sollerio videatur. Nec certe injuria cum eadem sit manus. At scitu dignum est, qua de causa tantum honoris deferat Pratensi codici: nempe quod omnes optimae fidei codices concorditer hoc die Calocerum posuerint. Argumentandi ordo videbitur fortasse praeposterus, praesertim cum apud Sollerium Pratensis codex vetustatis titulo principatum teneat. Bouillart.] martyris.

## XIII *Kal. Die* 20.

[0859]

In Asia, natalis sancti Archippi commilitonis beati Pauli, cujus meminit idem Apostolus in epistola sua scribens Colossensibus. Apud Britanniam, depositio sancti Chutberti, qui ex anachoreta, ecclesiae Lindisfarnensis antistes totam ab infantia ad senium vitam miraculorum signis inclytam duxit. In Syria, sanctorum Pauli, Cyrilli, Eugenii cum aliis quatuor. Ipso die, sancti Vulfrani confessoris.

## XII *Kal. Die* 21.

[0861]

Apud Cassinum castrum, natalis sancti Benedicti abbatis, hujus vitam virtutibus et miraculis gloriosam, beatus papa scribit Gregorius. Alexandriae, beati Serapionis anachoretae, magnarum virtutum viri. In territorio Lugdunensi, sancti Lupicini abbatis, cujus vita sanctitatis, et miraculorum gloria illustris fuit.

## XI *Kal. Die* 22.

[0863]

Apud Septimianam civitate Biterris, depositio sancti Afrodisii episcopi et confessoris. Hic a beato Paulo [0865] Narbonensi episcopo eidem urbi ordinatus antistes, fidei documentis praeclarus virtutumque meritis ornatus, quievit in pace.

## X *Kal. Die* 23.

[0867]

In Africa, sanctorum martyrum Victoriani, Frumentii et alterius Frumentii et duorum germanorum, qui persecutione Wandalica, ut scribit Victor Africanus episcopus, sub Hunerico rege, pro constantia catholicae confessionis, immanissimis suppliciis excruciati, egregio martyrio coronati sunt. In Antiochia, sancti Theodori presbyteri. Civitate Caesarea, sancti Juliani.

## IX *Kal. Die* 24.

[0869]

Romae, passio beati Pigmenii presbiteri. Hic Julianum apostatam a puero nutrivit et sacris litteris erudivit, a quo ipse postea in Tyberim pro fide Christi necatus est. In Mauritania, natalis sanctorum Romuli et Secundoli fratrum, qui pro Christo nati sunt. Apud Syriam, sancti Seleuci. Item in Phrygia, sancti Agapiti.

## VIII *Kal. Die* 25.

[0871]

Apud Nazareth civitatem Galilaeae, Annuntiatio Dominica. In Sirmio, passio beati Hirenei episcopi, tempore Maximiani imperatoris, qui primo tormentis acerrimis vexatus, dein diebus plurimis in carcere cruciatus, novissime abscisso capite consummatus est. Romae, sancti Cyrini martyris. qui a rege Claudio, post facultatum amissionem, post carceris squalorem, post multorum verberum afflictionem gladio interfectus est. Nicomediae, natalis Dulae cujusdam militis ancillae, quae pro castitate occisa est. In Antro insula sancti Hermelandi abbatis, cujus gloriosa conversatio miraculorum collaudatur praeconio.



## VII *Kal. Die* 26.

[0875]

Apud Pentapolim Libiae, natalis sanctorum Theodori episcopi, Hirenei Diaconi, Serapionis et Ammonii lectorum. Romae via Lavicana, sancti Castoli martyris, qui, ut in gestis beati Sebastiani legitur, a persecutoribus tertio appensus, tertio auditus, in confessione Domini perseverans, missus est in foveam, et dimissa super eum massa arenaria, martyrio migravit ad Christum. In Sirmio, sanctorum Montani presbyteri et Maximae in mare mersorum.

## VI *Kal. Die* 27.

[0879]

In Aegypto, depositio beati Joannis heremitae, qui inter caetera virtutum insignia, etiam prophetico spiritu plenus, Theodosio imperatori Christianissimo victorias de tyranno praedixit. In Pannonia, sancti Alexandri martyris. [ *Addit Bouillart.:* [cn: a | Hoc die sanctum Eucherium debuisse ab Usuardo collocari, non male negant Castellanus et Sollerius. Sed collocatum fuisse, nemo nisi pertinax, aut in dijudicandis scripturis plane hospes, negaverit. Si peccavit Usuardus, suo Periculo. BOUILLART.] Ipso die sancti Eucherii Turonensis episcopi.]

## V *Kal. Die* 28.

[0881]

I Conciliorum Galliae. BOUILLART.] Senones, sancti Leonis episcopi. *Et charactere cursivo:* Eodem die inventio sanctorum martyrum Dionysii, Rustici et Eleutherii.]

## IX *Kal. Die* 23.

[0963]

In Perside civitate Diospoli, passio sancti Georgii martyris, cujus gesta passionis etsi inter apocriphas numerantur scripturas, tamen illustrissimum ejus martyrium inter coronas martyrum Ecclesia Dei venerabiliter honorat. In Galliis civitate Valentia, natalis sanctorum Felicis presbiteri, Fortunati et Achillei diaconorum, qui cum maximam partem supradictae urbis ad fidem Christi convertissent, a duce Cornelio in carcerem trusi sunt, dein diutissime verberati, cruribusque confractis circa rotarum vertiginem stricti, fumum quoque in equulei suspensione perpessi, ad extremum gladio consummati sunt. [ *Addit Bouillart.:* [cn: a | In Carolino autographo scriptum erat: *apud Castrum Silvanectensium depositio sancti Reguli episcopi et confessoris*. Hic simpliciter, *episcopi et confessoris*. Cur omisit *depositio?* Nam satis supererat spatii ut adderetur. Hic Usuardi acumen et sagacitatem agnosco. Legit profecto S. Reguli acta: sed ea cum vidisset fabulis referta, nec ullam tuto eis haberi posse fidem; consuluit Ecclesiam quae res gestas Reguli et mortis diem studiosius memoriae mandare debuit. Haec autem ita parum cum Carolino autographo convenit, ut depositionem hoc die, translationem 30 Martii veneretur. Quid faceret Usuardus? Delevit quod XXX Martii scripserat. Et ne, signata depositione quam hodie memorant Acta, falleretur, satis habuit diem S. Regulo sacrum adnotare. BOUILLART.] Castro Silvaenectis, sancti Reguli episcopi et confessoris.]

## VIII *Kal. Die* 24.

[0967]

Lugduno Galliae, natalis sancti Alexandri martyris, qui persecutione Antonini Veri, post carceris custodiam, primo ita laniatus est crudelitate verberantium, ut crate soluta costarum, patefactis visceribus, interiora corporis panderentur. Dein crucis affixus patibulo, beatum spiritum exanimatus emisit. Passi sunt cum eo et alii numero triginta quatuor. Eodem die, depositio sancti Melliti episcopi in Britannia. Item civitate Heliberri, sancti Gregorii episcopi et confessoris.

## VII *Kal. Die* 25.

[0969]

Romae, Letania major ad sanctum Petrum. Apud Alexandriam, natalis beati Marci evangelistae. Hic discipulis et interpres apostoli Petri, rogatus Romae a fratribus scripsit Evangelium, quo assumpto, perrexit Aegyptum, primusque Alexandriae Christum annuntians constituit Ecclesiam, ac postea pro fide Christi tentus et graviter afflictus, primo angelica visitatione confortatus, deinde ipso Domino sibi apparente, ad coelestia regna vocatus est. Mortuus est autem octavo Neronis anno. Civitate Siracusa, sanctorum Evodii et Hermogenis [ *Bouillart., ad oram paginae:* Ipso die, Parisius, translatio corporis beati Droctovei abbatis, discipuli beatissimi Germani confessoris atque pontificis.]

## VI *Kal. Die* 26.

[0973]

Romae, natalis beati Anacleti papae qui secundus post apostolum Petrum, cum rexisset Ecclesiam annis duodecim, persecutione Domitiani martyrio coronatus est. Item Romae, sancti Marcellini pontificis, qui cum Ecclesiam novem annis et mensibus quatuor rexisset, a Diocletiano pro fide Christi cum Claudio, Cirino et Antonino capite truncatus est. Quo tempore fuit magna persecutio, ita ut intra unum mensem, decem et septem millia coronarentur. [cn: a | Hic inter puros locum a Sollerio non potuit obtinere infortunatus Pratensis codex, idque propter sancti Richarii mentionem, quam etsi non diffitetur ab eodem scriptore, alio tamen et magis flavescente atramento monitus est esse factam; aequitatem illius judicis! BOUILLART.] Monasterio Centula [ *Bouillart.,* in pago Pontivo], sancti Richarii presbiteri et confessoris.

## V *Kal Die* 27.

[0977]

Romae, depositio beati Anastasii papae, de quo sanctus Hieronymus venerabili testatur eloquio, quod ejus vita diuturna mundus immeritus sit frui. Apud Nicomediam, natalis sancti Anthimi episcopi et martyris, qui persecutione Diocletiani ob confessionem Christi, ut in historia ecclesiastica descriptum est, martyrii gloriam capitis obtruncatione accepit. Secuta est quoque illum universa pene gregis sui multitudo, per eamdem martyrii viam, quorum alios judex gladio obtruncari, alios ignibus conflagrare, alios naviculis impositos pelago immergi fecit. Tarso Ciliciae, sancti Castoris.

## IV *Kal. Die* 28.

[0979]

Apud Ravennam, natalis sancti Vitalis martyris, qui cum corpus beati Ursicini sublatum, honestate sepelisset, tentus a Paulino consulari, post equulei tormenta, jussus est deponi in foveam profundam, et terra ac lapidibus opprimi, talique martyrio migravit ad Christum. Alexandriae, sanctae Theodorae virginis, quae sacrificare contemnens, cum esset in lupanar tradita, repente quidam ex fratribus, nomine Didimus, miro Dei favore, illam eripuit, ac postea cum eadem percussus, et simul coronatus est. Eodem die, Afrodisii, Carilippi, Agapii et Eusebii martyrum. In Pannonia, sancti Pollionis martyris.

## III *Kal. Die* 29.

[0983]

Apud Paphum, sancti Tychici diaconi, discipuli beati Pauli. Hujus meminit in suis epistolis idem Apostolus, pronuncians eum fratrem carissimum ac conservum suum fore in Domino. In Numidia apud Cirtensem coloniam, natalis sanctorum martyrum Agapii et Secundini episcoporum, qui persecutione Valeriani, post longum exilium, apud praefatam urbem, in qua tum maxime gentilium rabies ad tentandam justorum fidem inhiabat, ex illustri sacerdotio effecti sunt martyres gloriosi. Passi sunt in eorum collegio Emilianus miles, Tertulla et Antonia, sacrae virgines, et quaedam mulier cum suis geminis.

## *Pridie Kal. Die* 30.

[0987]

Apud Lambesitanam urbem, natalis sanctorum martyrum Mariani lectoris et Jacobi diaconi, quorum prior, cum jam pridem infestationem Decianae persecutionis in confessione Christi evicisset, iterum cum carissimo collega tentus. Deinde post dira et exquisita supplicia, divinis revelationibus mirabiliter secundo confortati atque allevati, novissime cum multis aliis gladio consummati sunt. Civitate Sanctonas, beati Euprobi martyris, quem sanctus Clemens, pontificalis ordinis gratia consecratum, dixerit in Gallias, peractaque praedicatione, ob Christi testimonium, illiso capite, victor occubuit.
english:
HERE BEGINS THE MARTYROLOGY OF USUARDUS THROUGH THE CYCLE OF THE YEAR.

## PROLOGUE [nt: This prologue was lacking in the manuscript codex which we are making public, because its first leaf had fallen out through age. It was supplied to us, however, by the copy of the most distinguished man (V. C.) Pithou, of almost the same character both of script and of age, on the witness of Dom Jacques du Breul, a monk of this monastery, who prefixed this observation to the front of that Prologue. It is to be noted besides that it is not found in Sollerius's edition of Usuardus. Bouillart.] TO CHARLES THE BALD.

[0599A]To the most pious lord of kings, CHARLES, USUARDUS, an unworthy priest and monk: an everlasting crown in Christ.

It is by no means hidden from your Highness, O most wise prince, how we are admonished by the zeal of the ancients, worthy of imitation, that whatever in the acts, especially those agreeing with the doctrine of the Church, has been found less than perfect, we ought either to supply as far as we are able, or at least to desire that it be supplied. Which matter, with pious solicitude indeed (your command, if you remember, having been graciously applied), compelled me, though unworthy, to this: that I should gather into a certain unity, out of certain Martyrologies of the preceding Fathers, the sacred festivals of the saints which are to be recalled every year. And I recalled, in their very solemnities, [0599B] how many excesses of my own negligence, which I also desired to be purged by such an office. Besides, I was also provoked to this by the pious, though succinct, writings of the venerable presbyters, namely Jerome and Bede; of whom the former, studying brevity, and the latter, leaving very many days untouched, [0600A] are found to have passed over many things necessary to this work. Having followed them, however, I resolved also to follow the broader footsteps, already in this very undertaking, of Florus, a man worthy of memory, especially in the second book of the same. For there he both corrected and added many things which he had omitted in the first. But if anything, beyond what I received from them, has been done or changed in this work, it may be recognized that it was searched out by me with shrewd inquiry. For the rest, most kind one, I have preferred to insert this little preface of my littleness into this little work for this reason: that it might be known that I did not use levity in this endeavour, but rather obeyed your commands, as was fitting, which are wont to consult the benefit of the catholic faithful. Wherefore I beseech what is yours: that, if it be judged just, it may be strengthened by the proper anchor of your protection, namely that [0600B] it may be confirmed both for those present by the authority of royal examination, and for those to come by the examination of so great an authority. May the Lord, King of kings, deign to guard the excellence of your greatness with his power through many courses of years. Amen.

## ANOTHER PROLOGUE [nt: This second prologue is missing in the edition of Usuardus which Sollerius prepared; but it is found in almost all the handwritten codices of the same Usuardus which are kept in the library of the Prés, and in many others. Bouillart.], FROM THE BOOKS OF BLESSED AUGUSTUS [cj: *AUGUSTI*; read *AUGUSTINI*, "of Augustine"]. *How the saints are to be honoured.*

[0599]

[0599C]The ancient Fathers ordained that the festivals of the holy apostles or martyrs be celebrated in the mystery of veneration, either to stir up imitation, or that we may be associated with their merits and helped by their prayers [n: (AUG, l. XX, contr. Faust., c. 21)]. Yet in such a way that we sacrifice to none of the martyrs, but to the very God of the martyrs, although we set up altars in the memorials of the martyrs. For no one standing at the altar in the places of the holy bodies has ever said: We offer [0600C] to thee, Peter, or Paul, or Cyprian; but what is offered is offered to God, who crowned the martyrs: so that, from the love of those very places, the affection may rise up to increase charity, both toward those whom we are able to imitate, and toward him by whose help we may be able. We honour the martyrs, therefore, with that worship of love and fellowship with which holy men of God are also honoured in this life, whose heart we perceive to be prepared for such a passion for the truth of the gospel. But those the more devoutly, the more securely. [0601A] Whom we also proclaim with more confident praise as victors already in the happier life, than as still fighting in this one. But with that worship which in Greek is called *latria*, and in Latin cannot be said in one word, since it is a certain service properly owed to the Divinity, we neither honour anyone, nor teach that anyone is to be honoured, save the one God. And since the offering of sacrifice pertains to this worship, whence those are called idolaters who show this also to idols, in no way do we offer any such thing, or enjoin that it be offered, either to any martyr, or to any holy soul, or to any angel. And whoever slips into this error is rebuked by sound doctrine, either that he may be corrected, or that he may be condemned; since even the saints themselves, whether men or angels, do not wish [0602A] that to be shown to themselves which they know to be owed to the one God. This appeared in Paul and Barnabas, when the Lycaonians, moved by the miracles which were done through them, wished to sacrifice to them as to gods. For, having torn their garments, confessing and persuading them that they were not gods, they forbade these things to be done to them [n: (Act. XIV, 14)]. It appeared also in the angels, as also in the Apocalypse we read that an angel forbade himself to be adored, and said to his adorer: *I am thy fellow servant and of thy brethren; adore God [n: (Apoc. XIX, 10)]*. The martyrs, therefore, are to be honoured for imitation, not adored for religion. They are to be honoured with charity, not with servitude.

## JANUARY HAS 31 DAYS.

[0601]

## On the Kalends · 1 January

[0601]

The Circumcision of our Lord Jesus Christ. At Rome, the birthday of Saint Almachius, martyr; who, at the command of the prefect of the City, when he said: Today are the Octaves of the Lord's day; cease from the superstitions of idols [sic: *idorum*], was slain by the gladiators. On the Appian Way, the crowns of thirty soldiers, under the emperor Diocletian. Also at Rome, of Saint Martina, virgin, who, under the emperor Alexander, tormented with divers kinds of torments, at length obtained the palm of martyrdom by the sword. At Spoleto, of Saint Concordius, presbyter, and martyr, in the times of the emperor Antoninus; who, first beaten with cudgels, then hung upon the rack, and afterwards wasted with iron in prison, and there consoled by an angelic visitation, finally ended his life by the sword. In Caesarea of Cappadocia, the deposition of Saint Basil, bishop, whose feast is chiefly kept on the eighteenth day before the Kalends of July. In Africa, of blessed Fulgentius, bishop of the church of Ruspe, who, banished into exile on account of the catholic faith and his eminent doctrine, and at length permitted to return to his own church, renowned in life and word, rested in a holy end. In the territory of Lyon, of Saint Eugendus [Bouillart: *Augendi*], abbot, whose life shone forth full of virtues and miracles. At Alexandria, of Saint Eufrosina, virgin.

## The fourth day before the Nones · 2 January

[0605]

At Antioch, the passion of blessed Isidore, bishop. And in Pontus, in the city of Thomis, of three brothers, Argeus, Marcellus [0607] [Bouillart: *Narcissi*] and Marcellinus, a boy, who under the emperor Licinius, being seized among the recruits, when he would not serve as a soldier, was beaten to death, and, long wasted in prison, completed his martyrdom. In the Thebaid, of Saint Macharius, abbot.

## The third day before the Nones · 3 January

[0609]

At Rome on the Appian Way, the birthday of blessed Antheros, pope [nt: The Pratensis codex omits the word 'papae', says Sollerius, and reads 'cimiterio Calixti'. That on both counts he was misled by his informant, the text here given by us proves. Bouillart.], who, when he had ruled the Church twelve years, suffered under Maximian, and was buried in the cemetery of Calixtus. On the same day, of Saint Peter, who at the city of Aulana was slain by the punishment of the cross. In the Hellespont, of the holy martyrs Cyricus, Primus and Theogenes. In the city of Paris, of Saint Genevieve, virgin, who, dedicated to Christ by blessed Germanus, bishop of Auxerre, shone widely with admirable virtues and miracles.

## The day before the Nones · 4 January

[0613]

The birthday of blessed Titus, who, ordained bishop of the Cretans by the apostle Paul, and most faithfully fulfilling the office of preaching, obtained a blessed end, and was buried there at the church where he had been appointed a worthy minister. At Africa, of the most illustrious martyrs Aquilinus, Geminus, Eugenti, Martianus, Quintus, Theodotus, Triphon, whose acts are extant. At Rome, of the saints Priscus, presbyter, and Priscillianus, cleric, and Benedicta, a religious woman; who in the time of the emperor Julian completed their martyrdom by the sword. Also at Rome, of Saint Dafrosa, wife of Fabian the martyr, who after his slaying, first banished into exile, then by the aforesaid emperor was ordered to be punished by beheading. In the city of Bononia, of Hermes, Aggeus, and Gaius.

## On the Nones · 5 January

[0617]

At Rome, the birthday of blessed Thelesphorus, pope, who, ordained pontiff seventh after Peter the apostle, carried through an illustrious martyrdom. At Antioch, of Saint Simeon, monk, whose life and conversation were exceedingly admirable.

## The eighth day before the Ides · 6 January

[0619]

The Epiphany of the Lord. In the territory of Reims, the passion of Saint Macra, virgin; who, at the command of the governor Rictiovarus, when she had been cast headlong into fire and had remained unharmed, then, her breasts cut off, and afflicted by the filth of prison, rolled also upon most sharp potsherds [Bouillart adds: and live coals], passed to the Lord praying. At Rennes, of Saint Melanius, bishop and confessor, who, after signs of virtues, continually intent upon heaven, passed from the world.

## The seventh day before the Ides · 7 January

[0623]

The bringing back of the boy Jesus out of Egypt. On the same day, of blessed Lucian, presbyter of the church of Antioch, and martyr, who, quite renowned for doctrine and eloquence, suffered at Nicomedia for the confession of Christ under the persecution of Maximinus, and was buried at Helenopolis of Bithynia. At Antioch, of Saint Clerus, deacon, who for the glory of confession was tortured seven times and long wasted in prison, and at last, beheaded, completed his martyrdom. In the city of Heraclea, of Felix, Januarius.

## The sixth day before the Ides · 8 January

[0627]

At Naples of Campania, the birthday of Saint Severinus, bishop, and confessor, brother of the most blessed Victorinus, martyr; which Severinus, after the performance of many virtues, rested full of holiness. At Beauvais, of the holy martyrs Lucian, presbyter, Maxianus and Julian, of whom Maxianus and Julian were first punished with the sword by the persecutors. Then blessed Lucian, after excessive beating, since he had not feared to confess the name of Christ with living voice, himself also received the sentence of the former. On the same day, of Saint Eugenianus, martyr.



## The fifth day before the Ides · 9 January

[0631]

At Antioch under Diocletian and Maximian, the birthday of the saints Julian, and Basilissa, virgin, whose wondrous passions are read. From whose company also a venerable multitude of priests and of ministers of the church of Christ was burned with fire, which had fled to them on account of the savagery of the persecution. After whom Antoninus, presbyter, Anastasius and Celsus, a boy, together with his mother, and many others suffered. At Mauritania Caesariensis, of Saint Martiana, virgin. At Smyrna, of the saints Vitalis, Revocatus, and Fortunatus. [*In Bouillart . . . . .* suffered. [nt: Castellanus, the inspector of the codex itself, observes (the words are Sollerius's) that from that pretended autograph a leaf was once torn out and afterwards restored, in an old script too, on which that change was made, whereas the other Usuardine codices have: 'At Smyrna, of the saints Vitalis, Revocatus and Fortunatus': it is another leaf, I grant; whether another hand, I doubt; certainly the same cast of letters, the same age of both writings. Perhaps for a leaf fouled with erasures or corrections Usuardus substituted another; the same scribe may not have been at hand. Nor do I conjecture this rashly. For wherever the Dervensis codex differs from the Pratensis, in the latter there are erasures; or, if the page is clean, I notice a hand of the same period indeed, but yet another. To one inquiring into the cause of this, the following seemed probable, and approved by the constant practice of authors. Before Usuardus dictated the Martyrology he had corrected much, and after the dictation much: when a leaf had become too fouled for the writing to be read with ease, he tore the leaf out and substituted another. Grant, therefore, that Vitalis, Revocatus and Fortunatus belonged to the first autograph. In the second they gave place to Revolutus and Firminus. Whence were these sought? I do not know. New Acts of the saints emerge daily from the corners of libraries. Perhaps those which Usuardus saw will emerge. That Revolutus and Firminus are of the Africans or the Smyrnaeans whom the other Martyrologies record on this day cannot be affirmed, unless perhaps Usuardus was unlettered (ἀναλφάβητος). For neither does the number agree, nor is there any connexion of the names with one another. Bouillart.] In Africa, of the holy martyrs Revolutus and Firminus with three others.]

## The fourth day before the Ides · 10 January

[0635]

At Cyprus, of blessed Nichanor, deacon, of the first seven, who, admirable for the grace of faith and for virtue, was most gloriously crowned. In the Thebaid, the birthday of blessed Paul, the first hermit, whose soul Saint Anthony saw carried to heaven by angels among the choirs of the apostles and of the prophets.

## The third day before the Ides · 11 January

[0637]

In Africa, the birthday of blessed Salvius. On his birthday Saint Augustine made a sermon to the people at Carthage. At Alexandria, of the holy confessors Peter, Leucius, whose acts are extant.

## The day before the Ides · 12 January

[0641]

At Achaia, the birthday of blessed Satyrus, martyr, who, passing before a certain idol, when he had breathed out upon it, signing his own forehead, it at once fell down; for which cause he was beheaded. On the same day, of Saint Archadius, martyr, renowned in birth and in miracles. [In Bouillart: [nt: That this Archadius suffered at Caesarea in Mauritania, both the Acts of the same Archadius and other Martyrologies of Usuardus too attest. What shall we gather from this contest? That our codex, as it seems to Sollerius, was not written by Usuardus's hand? Not in the least. But that these Acts of Saint Archadius were either wholly unknown to Usuardus or not seen by him; and that hence he fell into that error which other later writers of his Martyrology corrected. Moreover, there could have come into Usuardus's hands some codices into which the same error had crept the more easily because at that time it seems to have been common. Our Ruinart, Act. select. Mart., p. 590, cites several, and by name two Colbertine ones, one of the Reverend Fathers of the Feuillants, and another given to the monastery of Saint-Remi as a gift of Hincmar, bishop of Reims, in which Saint Archadius is read to have suffered at Caesarea in Mauritania. To the same monastery the same prelate also gave a copy of the treatises of Saint Zeno, bishop of Verona, of which the thirty-ninth of the first book is headed thus: *On the birthday of Saint Archadius, who has his birthday on the day before the Ides of January in the city of Caesarea in Mauritania.* Bouillart.] In Caesarea of Mauritania, of Saint Archadius, martyr, renowned in birth and in miracles.]

## On the Ides · 13 January

[0645]

At Rome on the Lavican Way, the crowns of forty soldiers, which under the emperor Gallienus they deserved to receive for the confession of the true faith. In the city of Poitiers, the birthday of Saint Hilary, bishop and confessor, who, banished for four years into Phrygia on account of the catholic faith, among other virtues is said to have raised a dead man. At Reims the metropolis, the deposition of Saint Remigius, bishop, a man of eminent virtue. The proclamation of whose holiness, by the merit of its belief, the nation of the Franks solemnly recalls with the worship of due veneration. [Bouillart adds, in cursive type: [nt: Castellanus rightly observed that these words, 'On Mount Verziaco', etc., were added by a more recent hand. Yet this addition was the sole reason why Bollandus judged the Heriniensis codex purer than the Pratensis codex. Bouillart.] On Mount Verziaco, of Saint Viventius, confessor.

## The nineteenth day before the Kalends · 14 January

[0649]

At Nola of Campania, the birthday of Saint Felix, presbyter [Bouillart: *episcopi*] [nt: Here too Castellanus had eyes. The little space where 'episcopi' is read in the first hand was erased. Likewise the announcement of the second Saint Felix lies on an erasure, at least these words: *Also on the same day.* Whether it was enough for Usuardus that Saint Felix had been designated and elected bishop by the people, for him to call him bishop, I have no mind to inquire. I am bound to answer not for his meaning but for his words. As for his adding another Felix, if it is a fault, it was the fault of very many others, who differ in few things, as will appear below, and not of Usuardus alone. Ado himself mixed together the acts of two Felixes, of whom other martyrologists before Usuardus said that the one was the brother of the other. Lamentable is the lot of one who followed guides not at all safe; and in this matter Sollerius ought to be the fairer toward Usuardus, the more manifestly he is himself caught in the fault which he would reprehend in him. Bouillart.] and confessor, of whom blessed Paulinus writes that, when he was being sent into prison by the persecutors, and lay placed upon shells and potsherds, he was loosed by night by an angel and led out. On the same day, of Saint Eufrasius, bishop.

## The eighteenth day before the Kalends · 15 January

[0653]

Of Habakkuk and Micah, the prophets, whose bodies were found by divine revelation under the emperor Arcadius. At Egypt, of blessed Macharius, abbot, disciple of blessed Anthony, most celebrated both in life and in miracles. Also, of Saint Isidore, most distinguished in holiness of life, in faith and in miracles. In the city of Arverni, of Saint Bonitus, [0655] bishop and confessor, whose life shone with virtues. In the territory of Angers, of Saint [nt: Because Usuardus does not call Saint Maurus the disciple of blessed Benedict, Sollerius, not mindful enough of his own dialectic, concludes from this that Usuardus never thought of the disciple of Saint Benedict, and that, when the ninth century was already well advanced, Maurus of Angers was not customarily numbered among the disciples of Benedict by the Benedictines themselves. Whereas this one thing follows: that no other Maurus of Angers was known at that time besides the disciple of Saint Benedict, and that it therefore seemed superfluous to Usuardus to add any mark by which Maurus of Angers might be distinguished from another. But, he says, *who that is sober would believe that Usuardus would have kept silent about this, who a little before in the same text proclaimed Macarius the disciple of Antony?* No sober man fails to see why he said this of Macarius: namely, because there were several abbots named Macarius, one of them the disciple of Antony. But I ask in turn: what prudent man would believe that a holy abbot, who was the ornament and propagator of the Benedictine family, never came into the mind of a Benedictine and was passed over in compiling a catalogue of the saints? Bouillart.] Maurus, abbot.

## The seventeenth day before the Kalends · 16 January

[0657]

Rome, on the Salarian Way, the birthday of Saint Marcellus, pope, who for the defence of the catholic faith, at the command of the tyrant Maximinus, was first beaten with cudgels, then assigned under public custody to the service of the animals, and after many years of serving there, clad in a garment of haircloth, died. At Arles, of blessed Honoratus, bishop, whose life was illustrious in doctrine and in miracles. [Bouillart inserts: [nt: Sollerius struck out Saint Titianus, although the agreement of the manuscripts is such that he almost thought he must yield to the torrent. Why he nonetheless resisted, the cause was this observation of his informant: that in the Pratensis whatever had been written in the first hand between Arles and Saint Furseus had been deleted. It is true that there is an erasure here. But he who erased the place had written what stands above. He only packed the letters a little more closely, so that room might be given to Saint Titianus, whom he had passed over in the first autograph. That Titianus is the bishop of the city of Opitergium, whom the printed Martyrologies of Usuardus and the German Martyrology commemorate on this day; whose Acts Ferrarius compiled from ancient monuments of the church of Opitergium. Bollandus reports these things on this same day. Bouillart.] Also in the city of Odobergia, of Saint Titianus, bishop and confessor.] At the monastery of Parrona, of Saint Furseus, confessor.

## The sixteenth day before the Kalends · 17 January

[0663]

At the Thebaid, of blessed Anthony, monk, whose body, found by divine revelation under the emperor Justinian, was brought to Alexandria and buried in the church of Saint John the Baptist. At Langres, the birthday of the holy twins Speusippus, Elasippus and Melasippus. Who, when they were twenty-five years of age, were crowned with martyrdom together with their grandmother Leonilla, and Jonilla, and Neon, in the time of the emperor Aurelian. [0665]

[0669]

[0669]In Smyrna, the birthday of blessed Germanicus, martyr, who under Marcus Antoninus and Lucius Aurelius, through the grace of the power of God, shutting out the fear of bodily frailty, of his own accord provoked the beast made ready: ground by whose teeth, dying for him, he deserved to be incorporated into the true bread, that is, the Lord Jesus Christ. At Spoleto, of Saint Pontianus, martyr, in the times of the emperor Antoninus, whom the judge, having had him beaten most vehemently with rods for Christ, ordered to walk barefoot upon coals: harmed not at all by these, he was ordered to be hung upon the rack and iron hooks, and so to be thrust into prison; where he deserved to be comforted by an angelic visitation, after which, drenched with boiling lead, he was at length struck with the sword. [0673]

At Rome, the birthday of blessed Fabian, pope, who, when he had presided over the Church thirteen years, suffered martyrdom in the time of Decius, and was buried in the cemetery of Calistus. [0677]

The birthday of blessed Publius, bishop, who, second after Dionysius the Areopagite, nobly ruled the Church of the Athenians, and, most distinguished in virtues and shining in doctrine, is gloriously crowned for the martyrdom of Christ. [0709]

[0713]

[0717]

The birthday of blessed Ignatius, bishop and martyr, who ruled the church of Antioch third after Peter the apostle: and in the persecution of Trajan he is sent bound to Rome, where, in the presence of the same, the senate sitting around, he was first afflicted with most monstrous punishments of torments, then he is cast to the lions, and, choked by their teeth, becomes a victim of Christ. At Smyrna, of Saint Pionius, martyr, who after the filth of prison, where he strengthened many of the brethren by his exhortations to the endurance of martyrdom, harassed with many torments, fixed with nails, and placed upon a burning pyre, obtained a blessed end of life for Christ. There suffered with him also fifteen others. On the same day, of blessed Ephrem, deacon of the church of Edessa. In the town *Tricastrinum*, of Saint Paul, bishop, [0719] whose life both shone with virtues, and his precious death is commended by miracles. In Scotia, of Saint Brigid, virgin, whose life shone with miracles.

[0721]

The *Ypapanti* of the Lord. At Caesarea, of the most blessed Cornelius, the Centurion, whom blessed Peter baptized. He, raised at the aforesaid city to the episcopal honour, rested. At Rome on the Salarian Way, the passion of Saint Apronianus, who, hearing together with Sisinnius the deacon, while still a gentile, a voice made from heaven, *Come,* saying, *ye blessed of my Father* and the rest; believing, was baptized, and so afterwards in the confession of the Lord received the end of life by a capital sentence. [0723] Also at Rome, of the saints Fortunatus, Felicianus, Firmus, Candidus. At Orléans, of Saint Fuscolus, bishop.
